title: KEYS FOLLOW THE DEVICE
why: His order of 2026-10-09: a raid line names the key of the device in hand, in the shooter voice. Knocked down in the middle of a pull said Hold E to try again even with a controller in hand, where the pull is on X. His words stay word for word; only the E is now the key the pull is on, so an unmoved keyboard reads exactly as before. The auto-jog lines are now STOP FIRST, AUTO-JOG ON and AUTO-JOG OFF, with the bound key in the detail.
now: Knocked down mid-pull names the pull key of the device in hand, and the auto-jog lines are caps headlines.
